title: 🚨 STOP PRAYING FOR GOD TO USE YOU... UNTIL YOU READ THIS.
paragraphs: 🚨 STOP PRAYING FOR GOD TO USE YOU... UNTIL YOU READ THIS.
Most people ask:
"God, use me."
Very few ask:
"God, what must I lose first?"
That question changes everything.
Because throughout Scripture, God prepared people through surrender before He released them into purpose.
Joseph lost comfort.
Moses lost the palace.
David lost anonymity.
Paul lost status.
And maybe...
God is asking you to lose something too.
WHAT YOU MUST LOSE BEFORE GOD CAN USE YOU
This powerful book exposes the hidden things that often block believers from stepping into God's purpose.
Not because God doesn't love them.
Not because God isn't calling them.
But because He is preparing them.
If you've been feeling stuck, delayed, frustrated, overlooked, or spiritually stagnant...
This message may be exactly what you need.
🔥 INSIDE YOU'LL DISCOVER:
✅ Why pride silently destroys purpose
✅ The danger of needing people's approval
✅ Why God often delays what He intends to bless
✅ How hidden sin limits spiritual growth
✅ What bitterness steals from your future
✅ Why comfort can become an idol
✅ How surrender unlocks God's next assignment
✅ What God gives back after true obedience
This is a biblical wake-up call.
⚔️ MOST PEOPLE VS FEW PEOPLE
Most people want promotion.
Few people embrace preparation.
Most people want breakthrough.
Few people embrace surrender.
Most people ask God to bless their plans.
Few people surrender to God's plan.
Most people want to be used.
Few people are willing to be changed.
Which one are you?
